recipe.visualDefinition: A solitary figure sits in an ornate bentwood rocking chair on the edge of a rugged coastal cliff, playing an acoustic guitar against a vast, overexposed sky and a calm ocean horizon.
coreVisualRelationships: The figure in the chair acts as the central focal point against a massive negative space.
The diagonal line of the cliff edge creates a sense of precariousness and depth.
The high-key sky blends seamlessly into the ocean, creating a dreamlike, ethereal atmosphere.
The dark silhouette of the figure and chair provides a sharp tonal contrast to the bright background.
coreInvariants: The bentwood rocking chair with its distinctive curved frame.
The high-horizon line that emphasizes the scale of the sky.
The specific placement of the subject at the lower-center intersection.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned in the lower-middle third, appearing small against the expansive landscape to emphasize isolation.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark mass of the rocking chair and the seated figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the dark figure, moves upward into the vast sky, and then follows the cliff edge down toward the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extremely high; the sky and ocean occupy approximately 70% of the frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated pale blue and white (sky and sea).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep charcoal and dark mahogany (figure and chair).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation background contrasted with low-value, medium-saturation foreground elements.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a washed-out, vintage film look

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating in the negative space of the sky

composition.position: Top left and top right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying rotations and placements to create a frame.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric construction and heavy weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle photograph of a person with dark hair sitting in a light-colored bentwood rocking chair on the edge of a sandy, rocky cliff. The person is playing an acoustic guitar. The background is a vast, hazy, overexposed sky that meets a calm ocean at a high horizon line. The lighting should be bright and diffused, creating a vintage 1970s film look with soft grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a bold geometric sans-serif like Futura Extra Bold, place the main title in the top center. Place secondary words in the top-left and top-right corners, rotated approximately 15 degrees to lean toward the center. All text should be in dark charcoal or black.

verificationChecks: Is the rocking chair a bentwood style?
Is the text extra-bold and tightly spaced?
Is the horizon line high in the frame?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or album titles
Do not replicate the exact small catalog number in the bottom right

mustAchieve: Strong geometric contrast between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic interaction between the chair and the ground.
Ensure the guitar scale is proportional to the figure.
Verify the text rotation doesn't obscure the subject.
Confirm the color palette remains muted and earthy.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solitary subject + expansive high-key negative space + bold geometric typography frame.
